source.name: Betsson Group, 'Betsson Group becomes main partner of Club Brugge'
source.quote: Betsson Group will be the new official main partner of Club Brugge. The three-year agreement represents the largest shirt sponsorship deal in the club’s history
source.note: Opened via Wayback Machine snapshot 20251216055347 because betssongroup.com blocks bots. No figure is reported in the announcement, so value is null.

note: Three-year main-partner deal from June 2025. The announcement says betFIRST.sport fronts the domestic jersey and betsson.sport the European-competition kits; the 2026-27 home shirt (Jupiler Pro League) carries betsson.sport on the chest. Described as the largest shirt sponsorship deal in the club's history; no amount disclosed.
